additional_info.subject: ID0411970-DC/Si-D/DE[RmglQs] - PowerConverter E17 CRM:00315002437
additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
Mr. Marcel Grossmann raised this ticket regarding a PowerConverter with Error17. I checked for the last 4 weeks and it had 78 occurrences.
My first recommendation is a simple swap of converters to understand if the cause is indeed the converter or the communication cables (CAN). This converter is in DC1 group, so what you will do is plug out this converter entirely, select a neighbour one from DC1 too (for example) and swap them.
If the error is persisting in the same converter where the error is first found (
2102312VGQKXNA000470SA002204000204FW:DC116PF000H100
) then we need to replace the converter.
If the error is now on the working converter, then the CAN cables need to be replaced.
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0411970 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-
